mistake_reason: At step 16, Assistant unexpectedly reset and treated the ongoing task as a new conversation, disregarding the previously extracted five ORCID identifiers and the interim correct aggregation (26.4). This context amnesia (FM-1.4) led the team to re-open the file and only extract three IDs, recomputing the average on an incomplete subset and producing the incorrect final answer (24.0).
